journey.name: Jade Not Set Up
journey.description: Connects a Jade emulator with no wallet on it and checks that the Found step names the problem. Requires `JADE_MNEMONIC= ./scripts/jade-emulator start` in `bitkit-docker`, a regtest debug build with the Jade emulator enabled (see the README) and no Jade paired.

actions.action: Launch the Bitkit app and go to the wallet home screen
Open the menu (testTag "HeaderMenu"), tap Settings (testTag "DrawerSettings"), tap "Hardware Wallets" (testTag "HardwareWalletsSettings") and tap "Add Hardware Wallet" (testTag "AddHardwareWallet")
Tap "Continue" (testTag "HardwareWalletIntroContinue") and verify the "Found Device" step (testTag "HardwareWalletFoundScreen") headed "Found Jade" appears within 15 seconds

Tap "Connect" (testTag "HardwareWalletFoundConnect") and verify that within 30 seconds the Found step shows "This Jade has not been set up yet. Create or restore a wallet on the device, then try again." (testTag "HwFoundError") and a "Connect" button to retry
